A deployment record that omits the flagship is worse than no record, because it gets trusted. issuedSubnames.name: aave-guard-fork.atlas-apps.eth
issuedSubnames.note: Issued 2026-07-26 by an end-to-end test of the new publish-an-existing-app path. Agentic ID token 12. BROKEN ON PURPOSE OF RECORD: its MiniAppRegistry entry does not exist — registerFork reverted ParentUnknown because the fork's parent (aave-guard) is unpublished, and the revert was swallowed as a generic 'registry write failed' after the ENS records and the mint had already landed. So the name resolves and the token exists while the 0G registry does not assert the name: mutuallyVerified reads false. This is the artifact that exposed the bug; the fix is the parent-existence check in agentic-id.ts registerMiniApp.

verifiedSubname.name: atlas-market-guard.atlas-apps.eth
verifiedSubname.note: Re-nominated 2026-07-26. This field previously named aave-health-guard, whose manifest no longer fetches (bytes lost to IPFS_MODE=local) and which has no addr record and mutuallyVerified false — so the one name the record held up as verified was the weakest of the set. atlas-market-guard is the name that actually carries the claim: addr set, contenthash fetches from ipfs.io, Agentic ID token 10, and all three verification legs true. Confirmed by GET /api/resolve/atlas-market-guard, which reads the records off Sepolia and fetches the CID rather than trusting this file.

manifestAvailability.note: Whether each name's contenthash still resolves, checked 2026-07-26 against ipfs.io — a gateway that is not ours. The three unavailable names were published while IPFS_MODE=local, whose content store (web/.atlas/, gitignored) was the only provider of their bytes. Those bytes are gone, so ipfs.io returns 504 and permanently will: a CID is the hash of its bytes, so regenerating the manifest yields a different CID that no longer matches the chain. Unrecoverable by pinning; only a re-publish would fix it. IPFS_MODE is now pinata, so this cannot recur. scripts/pin-backfill.ts --verify pinned the 8 documents whose bytes survived, 8/8 read back from ipfs.io.

registryGap.note: Names whose ENS records and Agentic ID are live but which MiniAppRegistry does not assert, so mutuallyVerified reads false. Checked 2026-07-26 by reading get(nameKey) off 0G Galileo. Cause and fix are in the aave-guard-fork note above. Repairable by re-registering; left as-is because it is the evidence.
